comment: The Python the installer carries, and its two libraries: each file fetched once into build/installer/cache/ and used only when its SHA-256 matches. numpy and Pillow are the versions the HD tools were run with (the HD pieces must come out the same); Python is the last 3.13 maintenance release with Windows binaries. The fonts: Televo's free KH Re:Collection fonts, DaFont's package of them, from which the installer keeps the ones the Menu Overhaul's pieces are drawn with (installer/fonts).

fonts.name: khmenu.zip
fonts.what: Televo's Kingdom Hearts Re:Collection fonts (free; credit appreciated): the Menu Overhaul's KHMenu and KHGummi
